# Tester Task Scripts

## Owner / Organizer

1. Sign in.
2. Create a game.
3. Invite another player.
4. Set turn order.
5. Configure the card deck.
6. Create or save the initial map.
7. Add starting community notes.
8. Start the game.
9. Find whose turn it is.
10. Explain what needs to happen next.

## Active Player

1. Open the game.
2. Find the current turn/card.
3. Read the discussion.
4. Create a Story Poll.
5. Save a draft outcome.
6. Review or update the map if available.
7. Commit & Advance.
8. Confirm the next active player.

## Passive Player

1. Open the game.
2. Identify whose turn it is.
3. Send a chat message.
4. Vote in the Story Poll.
5. Inspect the saved draft.
6. Open the map.
7. Find official history.
8. Explain what is official and what is still discussion.

## Mobile Tester

1. Accept invite.
2. Sign in.
3. Open the game.
4. Read the current turn.
5. Send a chat message.
6. Vote in the Story Poll.
7. Open the map full-screen.
8. Pan and zoom the map.
9. Review State.
10. Review History.
11. Explain what can and cannot be done from mobile.

## Archive Reviewer

1. Open the archive.
2. Find the final map.
3. Find the official timeline.
4. Find a past decision.
5. Find project/resource/discontent state.
6. Open collapsed chat log.
7. Explain what happened in the world from the archive alone.
